About the conference

A Collective Concern

Nigerian teenage boys increasingly lack authentic male mentorship and positive role models, leaving a void being filled by negative influencers, trending algorithms and street-level values that push get-rich-quick schemes, yahoo-yahoo, fraud, and other vices that do not build character. This is partly because exemplary and accomplished men leaders are rarely in the room and available to mentor and shape boys in their most formative years.

Our Response

We are hosting the Positive Role Models Conference for Boys 2026. The convening will bring 15 accomplished male CEOs in the same room to model authentic pathways to sustainable success to 500 boys physically, and hundreds of other senior secondary school boys via viewing. Our message is that lasting wealth is created through vision, hard work and determination and the men in the room exemplify it.

Questions

Frequently asked questions

Who can attend?

Senior secondary school boys (SS1 to SS3). Seats are limited to 500 boys, and each boy must register with a parent or guardian's details.

Is it free?

Yes. Entry is free, lunch included. Registration is required.

What should he bring?

Your registration ID (on your phone or printed), a pen and a notebook. Leave valuables at home.

What about parents and guardians?

A parent or guardian must give consent when registering and will receive the confirmation by email and WhatsApp. To ask about accompanying your son, call or email us.

Will lunch be served?

Yes. Lunch is part of the programme. Tell us about any allergies or dietary needs in the registration form.

Is there a dress code?

Come neat and comfortable, in smart-casual clothes.
